title: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
description: A single-player fantasy RPG inspired by Belle Époque France. A party of expeditioners sets out to stop the Paintress from erasing people, combining turn-based decisions with real-time dodges, parries, and attacks.

player_sentiment.summary: In two sampled r/patientgamers discussions, players praise the hybrid combat, build experimentation, music, and dramatic premise. Opinions differ on the story's payoff, exploration, and side content. Some find repeated encounters and powerful builds undermine pacing or challenge. This limited sample is not representative of all players.
positives: Engaging combination of turn-based strategy and real-time reactions
Creative character builds and passive ability combinations
Memorable music and an intriguing dramatic premise
negatives: Repetitive enemies and uneven side content for some players
Exploration and navigation can feel unrewarding or confusing
Story payoff and combat balance divide opinion
